Kafka died shortly afterwards, but not before she argued with Rhoa for one last time.

'''Kafka''' is one of the playable character in the Grand Quest. She was the captain of the Sixth Division of Demon Slayers.

==Debut Appearance==
She appeared in Krantz's squad, countering {{c|Rhoa}}'s opinion, and ended up arguing with him.

==In the storyline==
Kafka was a scientist who studied the demonic arts in the Randall Empire. She was born in a family of magicians. When she joined Summoners' Hall, she found ancient texts about the demonic arts, unlocking a myriad of lost knowledge from them. It was thanks to her knowledge of magic and {{c|Rhoa}}'s knowledge of otherworldly technologies that Summoner's Research Lab was established.

After the ambush of the demon beast, {{c|Rhoa}} ordered the rest of the squad to go without him. Kafka read through Rhoa's plan, and decided to follow Rhoa to fight the demon beast. She arrived right before Rhoa attacked the demon beast. After a little squabble, Kafka showed her altered appearance (as shown in [[Sinister Basilisk Kafka|the unit's final evolution]]) to Rhoa, much to the latter's shock due to demonic power Kafka exerted from her new form. She and Rhoa then engaged in a fierce battle against the demon beast, until she fell due to the wounds she suffered. Kafka died shortly afterwards, but not before she argued with Rhoa for one last time.

==Personality==
{{c|Grahdens}} stated that Kafka has a little strange personality. In the Grand Quest, Kafka is shown as a sassy woman, who likes to tease her comrades, especially {{c|Rhoa}}.
